name: Lateral Step Over

instructions.description: Stand sideways next to a low step or line on the floor.
Step one foot over the object, then bring the other foot across to follow.
Continue stepping side to side with a steady rhythm while staying tall through the trunk.
Slow down and step away from the object carefully.

performanceMetrics.notes: Can be used as a balance or low-impact cardio drill.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Progress to lateral hopping once stepping control is strong.

commentsNotes: Use a low obstacle that will not cause tripping.
Do not cross the feet excessively.
